probe.title: Your Page Title
probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Halden® Pricing Changelog Help Blog About Overview Buy Halden App Store Google Play © 2026 Halden® Getting started Sync across your devices Keep today's thing and your record the same on your phone, iPad and watch. Everything you do in Halden is stored on your phone first, so the app works offline and opens instantly. With Pro, the same thing, focus sessions and record also follow you to your other devices. Turn on sync On your phone, go to Settings , then Account , and sign in with your email. Tap Sync and switch it on. Sign in with the same email on your iPad or Android tablet. Your record appears within a few seconds. Apple Watch does not need its own sign in: it picks up today’s thing from the iPhone it is paired with. What syncs Today’s thing and tomorrow’s, if you have already picked it Small steps under each thing Focus sessions, including one that is running right now Your full record of done days Settings such as the reminder time stay on each device, so you can be reminded on your phone and not on your iPad. When sync is slow Check that each device is online and signed in to the same email under Settings , then Account . Pull down on Today to refresh.
